cinematic_dialogue:2:1521004001:.text: That's an order! Directly from the Regulus!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521004002:.text: I'm sorry, Regulus Abundius, but I can't follow that command.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006001:.text: Why won't he follow the Regulus' order?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006001:.source_cn: 他为什么不听领主的命令？
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006001:.male: Why won't he follow the Regulus' order?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006001:.female: Why won't he follow the Regulus' order?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006002:.text: He believes Abundius is too young to lead.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006002:.source_cn: 阿邦德年纪太小，没法掌权
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006002:.male: He believes Abundius is too young to lead.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006002:.female: He believes Abundius is too young to lead.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006003:.text: Who are you? How dare you disrespect the Regulus!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006003:.source_cn: 你们是谁，敢对领主出言不逊？！
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006003:.male: Who are you? How dare you disrespect the Regulus!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521006003:.female: Who are you? How dare you disrespect the Regulus!

say:4:1521005001:0.text:
But why?
If we don't help those civilians now, they'll die!
say:4:1521005001:0.source_cn: 为什么不听我的？\n再不帮那些平民，他们会死的！

say:5:1521005002:1.text: My apologies, Regulus Abundius. The rain's still pouring, and the flood could rise again at any moment. I have to prioritize your safety.
say:5:1521005002:1.source_cn: 抱歉，殿下。暴雨尚未停歇，洪水也不知道会不会再次上涨…...

say:6:1521005003:0.text: Our soldiers are already out assisting the victims. Please, it's not safe to stay here. We should head to higher ground!
say:6:1521005003:0.source_cn: 军队已经在救援受灾的人了，请您不要在这里停留，赶快回到...

say:7:1521005004:0.text: The soldiers... they're all deployed outside the city. There's hardly anyone left here to help!
say:7:1521005004:0.source_cn: 军队……军队全都驻扎在外面，城里根本没有多少人能帮忙……！

say:8:1521005005:0.text: I don't need protection, but they do! I am their Regulus, and I have a duty to protect them!
say:8:1521005005:0.source_cn: 你快去救救他们！我是领主，必须保护呼临城居民的安全！

say:9:1521005006:0.text: I'm sorry, Regulus Abundius. I can't carry out that order.
say:9:1521005006:0.source_cn: 殿下，属下真的无法听从您的命令。

say:10:1521005007:1.text: Regulus <style="highlight">Herennus'</style> final command was to keep you safe. I won't go against his last will.

say:11:1521005008:0.text: If something happened to you, I...
say:11:1521005008:0.source_cn: 要是您出了什么差错，属下——

say:12:1521005009:0.text: Stop using <style="highlight">my father's</style> name as an excuse to ignore my orders!

say:13:1521005010:0.text: I'm the Regulus now. It's my orders you should be following!
say:13:1521005010:0.source_cn: 现在我才是呼临城的领主！你应该听我的，快去救人！

say:15:1521005012:0.text: If you won't obey, I will have Perseus replace you!
say:15:1521005012:0.source_cn: 你、你要是再不听令，我……我就让珀尔修斯把你换掉！

say:16:1521005013:0.text: If that's the price of keeping you safe, so be it—even if it means going to prison.
say:16:1521005013:0.source_cn: 属下甘愿领罚。只要能保证您的安全，哪怕让属下一辈子待在...

narration:22:1502281402:0.text: Gala's whispered comments draw attention. Abundius orders the guards to arrest you.
narration:22:1502281402:0.source_cn: 加拉的低声议论不小心引来了注意，阿邦德下令让侍卫抓捕你们。

narration:23:15022814:0.text: In the Halia square, Regulus Abundius is arguing with his guards.
narration:23:15022814:0.source_cn: 呼临城广场上，领主阿邦德正在和他的侍卫争吵。
